title: 08. Files & Errors: Custom Exceptions

sections.title: Explanation (Like You're a Junior Developer)
sections.body:
**Custom exceptions** are exception classes you define yourself. They let you create domain-specific errors that are meaningful in your application's context — instead of using generic `ValueError` or `RuntimeError` everywhere.

**Why custom exceptions matter:**
- 🎯 Callers can catch YOUR specific error, not broad `Exception`
- 📖 Error messages are self-documenting
- 📦 Can carry extra data (error codes, context, retry hints)
- 🌳 Can build an exception hierarchy for your domain
